review.imagery: 47 gallery entries include 7 dated construction photographs. All 23 official primary assets, the entire 45-page brochure index, 23 native resources and all seven September 2026 site photographs were visually reviewed. Two byte-identical primary repeats and four native texture panels are excluded. Nineteen brochure scenes add original architectural, lobby, library, home and duplex angles. Some interior concepts also appear in other Imtiaz project marketing. Each selected asset is independently published on this project’s own official page or branded brochure and retains conceptual scope. The complete street building supplies card and hero.
review.floorPlans: All eleven complete original sheets were visually reviewed on three contacts. Three freely displayed broker 1 BR previews were separately inspected at native size. No numerical area appears on them. The remaining broker layouts are form-gated and were left unretrieved. The separate roof/upper duplex portions are not assigned a second whole-home area. Eleven complete building sheets show ground, both podiums, residential levels and the roof. Grouped floors and the 3 BR duplex portions retain their original labels. Three separately attributed broker images add 1 BR previews. No numerical individual saleable areas are printed on these drawings. Their category ranges are not assigned to a numbered home. Confirm final unit areas and revisions with Imtiaz.
review.location: Original brochure pages 9–12 were rendered at 3200 pixels. Complete map 10 and sun/view diagram 12 were visually read. The fifteen-minute headline is a broad claim without separate route/time assignments. Gold Souq station is a mainland contextual marker and does not establish doorstep rail access. The island masterplan and surrounding buildings remain proposed. No explicit coordinate pair appears in the current official named-place embed.
review.provenance: Current official HTML/gallery and September 2026 history pages retain dated URL and byte/hash receipts. Branded brochure and building-plan mirrors retain honest Mitchell’s or Reelly attribution. Open broker plan-image URLs were observed in public figures. Source bytes, complete drawing sheets and notices are preserved. Original completed text research and protected identities remain intact.

unavailable: Individual contractual saleable areas, numbered-unit matching for broker previews, detailed developer unit sheets, form-gated additional broker layouts, exact visitor entrance, individually sourced route times, current certified site completion and guaranteed views remain unavailable or unverified.
